docs.theEmblemIsOptionalOmittingItLeaves: The emblem is optional. Omitting it leaves no empty logo space. The example path represents an institution-provided asset; the library does not bundle official insignia.
docs.pageIsACompleteExampleRatherThanA: Page is a complete example rather than a separate library component. It combines Header, ServiceNavigation, Breadcrumbs, PageHeader, Grid, form fields, Alert and Footer. See those component pages for their APIs.
docs.nativeHTMLAriaAndDataAttributesAreA: Native HTML, aria-* and data-* attributes are available where allowed by the component types. Component-specific properties are extracted from TypeScript when generating documentation.
docs.compositionAccessibilityDependsOnLa: Composition accessibility depends on labels, element semantics, focus order and application context. Library themes and behaviours are checked against the documented examples; those results do not assess the consuming service. The matrix and limitations are described in
docs.experimentalAPIExamplesUseTheSameVe: Experimental API. Examples use the same version as the library. The contribution process is described in
docs-patterns.patternsCombineComponentsF: Patterns combine components for specific tasks. Variants share one page with separate examples. Examples use fictional data; demonstration forms do not contact external services.
docs-patterns.thisPageGroupsRelatedScena: This page groups related scenarios within one pattern. Each section has its own example and React and HTML source.
docs-patterns.examplesUseLibraryComponen: Examples use library components. Server validation, messaging, payment processing and persistence are implemented by the application. Demonstration interactions stay local and do not persist after reload. JavaScript setup is documented once in
docs-guides.theHeaderIdentityUsesTheRoma: The header identity uses the Romanian flag RGB values expressed as hex colours. The blue and red rule are identical in the documentation and Header component, including dark appearance. Yellow marks keyboard focus within the header.
docs-guides.theFlagColoursExportFromSdrC: The flagColours export from @strictlylucian/sdr-core exposes the same values in JavaScript. Semantic text, status and surface colours adapt to each theme for contrast.
docs-guides.buttonsUseFlagYellowForKeybo: Buttons use flag yellow for keyboard focus and while pressed. Toggle buttons retain this state while aria-pressed is true. Dark text and borders provide contrast against yellow; the focus indicator combines a yellow ring with a dark inner edge for light and dark surfaces. The skip-to-content link becomes visible on focus and uses the same colour pair.
docs-guides.statusReviewedOn25October202: Status reviewed on 25 October 2026. All components are experimental. An implementation does not represent accessibility certification or validation in a real service.
docs-guides.documentedComponentsAndExamp: documented components and examples, with variants included on their component pages, React and HTML examples, four themes and two densities.
docs-guides.patternsCoverQuestionsValida: patterns cover questions, validation, navigation, documents, checking answers and confirmation. Personal details, addresses and conventions are adapted to Romanian services. Each service must research these patterns with the people who use it.
docs-guides.variantsAreGroupedWithinThei: Variants are grouped within their parent patterns, with distinct examples and source for each scenario.
docs-guides.thereIsNoEditableOrVirtualis: There is no editable or virtualised grid, custom combobox, custom calendar or ARIA tree widget yet. The date picker is native, hierarchical navigation uses disclosures, and the menu uses ordinary links. Tables sort locally. The host implements persistence, server validation and business actions.
docs-guides.componentsPatternsAndGuidanc: Components, patterns and guidance for Romanian digital services.
layout-guide.headerServiceNavigationAndC: Header, service navigation and content share a 64rem limit (1024px at 16px/rem). Backgrounds may span the screen while text and controls stay centred. Side gutters are 16px, increasing to 32px at 40rem. Container adds no vertical spacing. Nested page containers add the side gutters again and are rarely needed for page structure.
layout-guide.aliasesForTheSameMaximumWid: Aliases for the same maximum width, centring and responsive gutters.
layout-guide.combineWithMainWrapperFor48: Combine with main-wrapper for 48px/64px top spacing when there are no breadcrumbs or back link.
layout-guide.increaseTopSpacingWhenMainI: Increase top spacing when main is the first child of its container; place breadcrumbs or back link before main.
layout-guide.wrappingFractionalGridWithT: Wrapping fractional grid with the shared gap token, without negative margins or gaps for unused columns.
layout-guide.fullWidthOnMobileChosenFrac: Full width on mobile; chosen fraction from 40rem.
layout-guide.applyTheFractionFrom64remCa: Apply the fraction from 64rem; can override the tablet fraction.
layout-guide.availableFractionsFullOneHa: Available fractions: full, one-half, one-third, two-thirds, one-quarter and three-quarters. Visual order follows HTML order. The sdr-u-width-* utilities use full width on mobile and the chosen fraction from 40rem; auto retains intrinsic sizing. Nested grids use another grid-row without another width-container.
layout-guide.thePageExampleKeepsItsFormA: The Page example keeps its form and supporting information in one column below 64rem. The two-thirds-from-desktop and one-third-from-desktop variants place them side by side from that breakpoint, avoiding a cramped support column on tablets. Header allows the service name and language options to wrap; main navigation has a Menu button below 40rem. Reading order remains the same at every width.
layout-guide.headerAndServiceNavigationA: Header and ServiceNavigation already include the inner container. Placing them outside the main page container preserves the shared alignment. Side navigation stays inside its column without a page container. See the
layout-guide.exampleForTheCompleteCompos: example for the complete composition, including an aligned footer.
layout-guide.theSdrContainerTokenOnTheSd: The --sdr-container token on the .sdr root supports a different service width. A shared value preserves container alignment. At 40rem, --sdr-page-gutter switches to spacing token 6. Application overrides take precedence when declared after the library CSS, including at the breakpoint.
docs.errorStateGuidance: The error message is associated with the control through aria-describedby, and aria-invalid exposes its state. In React, error enables this presentation; the application owns validation rules and when messages appear. The HTML edition uses the same structure and CSS classes.
docs.disabledStateGuidance: The disabled attribute disables the control and excludes it from Tab navigation and submitted form data. Groups use disabled on the fieldset. A visible explanation can describe why a control is unavailable.
docs.readOnlyStateGuidance: The readOnly prop (readonly in HTML) keeps the value visible and included in submitted form data. Text fields remain focusable and their contents can be selected and copied, but not edited. Native date and time widgets retain the browser’s navigation behaviour. Date groups and Fieldset examples apply the state to each text field.
docs.staticStateGuidance: This control has no native HTML readonly attribute. The example uses SummaryList to display a fixed value. The application manages any value that must be submitted separately; disabled excludes a control from form data.
